movesets.name: Assault Vest
movesets.description:
Assault Vest Primarina is a great special tank while being a remarkable offensive threat itself, capable of trading hits against offensive teams. It can check threats like Walking Wake, Dragapult, Darkrai, and Iron Valiant and stomach even strong super effective hits from foes like Iron Moth and Raging Bolt, all while having a decent matchup against common physical attackers like Zamazenta, Great Tusk, and Cinderace. Psychic Noise hits Toxapex super effectively and blocks healing from walls like Blissey, Clodsire, and Clefable, allowing Primarina to chip them down for itself and its partners. It also lets Primarina pick off Zamazenta and Iron Moth behind a Substitute. Flip Turn turns Primarina into a pivot, letting it bring in a teammate in safely, either after being attacked or on predicted switches to gain momentum. Whirlpool can be used to stallbreak by trapping the likes of Blissey and Toxapex that may otherwise outlast Primarina, especially in conjunction with Psychic Noise to keep them low. While Torrent is preferred, Liquid Voice can be used on sets that forgo Surf to still maintain a strong STAB move from Psychic Noise; this also allows Primarina shut down even Tera Dark Blissey. Tera Poison and Steel improves its matchup against Iron Valiant, provides a poison immunity from foes like Pecharunt and Clodsire, and flip Primarina's Poison and Grass weakness against moves like Rillaboom's Wood Hammer and Iron Moth's Sludge Wave. Tera Poison lets Primarina maintain its decent matchup against Zamazenta and is better against Iron Moth and Focus Blast Darkrai, while Tera Steel lets it check Deoxys-S, Hatterene, and Galarian Slowking better and pivot more freely in the face of Stealth Rock. Tera Grass aids Primarina's matchup into Ogerpon-W and can help it against Raging Bolt in a pinch too. 176 Speed EVs let Primarina outspeed Adamant Kingambit and Ursaluna, while the remaining HP EVs allow Primarina to reach feats such as surviving Protosynthesis Thunderbolt from Raging Bolt, +1 Speed Booster Energy Iron Moth's Sludge Wave, +2 Gliscor's Earthquake, and two Heavy Slams from Zamazenta. However, a bulkier EV spread of 252 HP / 208 SpA / 48 SpD is also an option to survive two Tera Water Choice Specs Walking Wake's Hydro Steam under sun.

Assault Vest Primarina is best used on bulky offense teams that appreciate a Pokemon that has both offensive and defensive prowess, generally teams that are particularly weak to special attackers. Landorus-T provides Intimidate and checks the physical attackers that Primarina struggles with like Kingambit and Great Tusk. Great Tusk is another great teammate, as it provides entry hazard removal and checks Galarian Slowking, which tends to threaten Primarina. In return, Primarina can handle threats like Darkrai and Walking Wake. Kingambit and Weavile appreciate support from Primarina that can switch in on and threaten Pokemon like Iron Valiant and Zamazenta. Furthermore, both of these Pokemon help check Galarian Slowking for Primarina, along with resisting Grass-type attacks. Gholdengo appreciates Primarina's ability to check Fire-types like Cinderace and Heatran, as well as Walking Wake. Primarina struggles with Grass-types like Ogerpon-W, Meowscarada, and Rillaboom, so it's essential to have checks to these such as Rillaboom, Cinderace, and Kingambit. Cinderace, aside from resisting Grass-type attacks, can also help with hazard removal with Court Change, allowing Primarina to switch in more often. Dragapult and Cinderace can form a great pivoting core with Primarina, and they can also spread burn in order to help improve Primarina's matchup against physical attackers like Great Tusk.

movesets.name: Offensive Calm Mind
movesets.description:
Primarina is a fierce sweeper that can use its STAB moves, combined with Calm Mind, to muscle through most enemies. Primarina can choose between Surf for perfect accuracy or Hydro Pump for greater power that lets it 2HKO Galarian Slowking at +1. Substitute lets Primarina grab more Calm Mind boosts while slower Pokemon try to cripple Primarina with a status effect, like Toxic from Clodsire, Thunder Wave from Galarian Slowking, or Salt Cure from Garganacl, as well as easing prediction. It can use Psychic Noise to block healing from defensive Pokemon, including Slack Off from Galarian Slowking, Recover from Clodsire, and Wish from Alomomola, thus making them easier to beat. Encore is a niche option that lets Primarina lock opposing Pokemon into moves they don't care for, which can be especially effective in shutting down Kingambit and walls like Clefable and Sinistcha, forcing switches that can give it more opportunities to boost or attack. As for items, Primarina has good choices as well; its item can be Leftovers to grab more healing, pairing well with Substitute, while Heavy-Duty Boots can be used on teams with no entry hazard removal. Custap Berry is an option that allows Primarina to get one last attack before fainting, compensating for its middling Speed tier to trade more reliably against offensive teams. 176 Speed EVs allow Primarina to outspeed Adamant Kingambit. Tera Steel lets Primarina stay in and tank attacks from Grass-, Poison-, and Steel-types and hit them back hard; examples of these moves include Wood Hammer from Rillaboom, Sludge Wave from Iron Moth, and Make It Rain from Gholdengo. Its biggest claim to fame is being able to resist Galarian Slowking's STAB moves, turning one of its worst matchups into a setup opportunity. Tera Ghost gives it an immunity to Blissey's Seismic Toss, Dragonite's Extreme Speed, and Zamazenta's Fighting-type moves.

This Primarina set excels in hyper offensive structures as an early-game monster thanks to its good damage output and Calm Mind, which allow Primarina to destroy Kingambit, Heatran, Zamazenta, Clodsire, and many others. Kingambit loves the fact that Primarina can beat some of its counters like Skarmory, Corviknight, and Dondozo. Kingambit, in return, can beat Galarian Slowking and Blissey. The same applies to Iron Valiant, which appreciates Primarina's ability to counter Pokemon like Gholdengo and Skeledirge that can otherwise give it trouble. Thanks to Primarina's good matchup against defensive Ground-types like Clodsire and Ting-Lu, Pokemon like Gholdengo and Raging Bolt appreciate the help sweeping late-game. Primarina struggles against Pokemon that can either shut it down fast with super effective moves, like Ogerpon-W and Rillaboom, strong physical offense from the likes of offensive Great Tusk, or sturdy special walls such as Galarian Slowking and Blissey. Primarina loves the support from Landorus-T, which can scare away special walls with Earthquake, absorb Raging Bolt's Electric-type moves, support Primarina with Intimidate, allowing Primarina to take on strong physical offense, gain momentum from U-turn, which Landorus-T can easily obtain from common switch-ins like Gliscor, Alomomola, and Skarmory, and set up entry hazards to nab some good damage thresholds, like greatly improving the chance for Primarina to 2HKO bulky variants of Gholdengo and Kingambit with unboosted Surf. Iron Treads is another Ground-type that Primarina appreciates for its ability to check Galarian Slowking; it also provides Stealth Rock support, as well as Rapid Spin to clear the field of hazards. Another great partner is Rillaboom, since it also scares away the aforementioned Galarian Slowking and Blissey, as well as Great Tusk, and provides Primarina with extra healing from Grassy Surge. Dragapult is also a good teammate for Primarina because of its ability to check Ogerpon-W, spread status that can help Primarina either tank or outspeed opposing Pokemon more easily, and use U-turn to bring Primarina safely into the battle. Darkrai makes a good pairing due to its ability to beat Galarian Slowking and really appreciates Primarina's ability to beat both Clodsire and Iron Valiant. Offensive hazard setters like Glimmora, Hisuian Samurott, and Deoxys-S bring hazard pressure that can help Primarina break through walls more easily. Galarian Slowking provides pivoting with Chilly Reception and offensive pressure with Future Sight.

movesets.name: Bulky Calm Mind
movesets.description:
Thanks to a great typing and solid overall bulk, Primarina is one of the most dangerous set up sweepers in OU, capable of checking and setting up on offensive Pokemon like Zamazenta, Weavile, and Walking Wake. Calm Mind makes Primarina able to threaten the opposing team while also making itself harder to KO for potential revenge killers like Iron Valiant and Enamorus. Psychic Noise can be used in combination with Liquid Voice to cripple defensive switch-ins that would be able to beat it one-on-one, such as Dondozo, Unaware Clefable, and Clodsire. Surf is also an option to put more pressure on offensive teams due to it's higher Base Power while being run with Torrent, which can power it up in a pinch. It notably is useful against Gholdengo as well as threatening the 2HKO on bulky Kingambit after a Calm Mind. Substitute prevents Primarina from being affected by status moves such as Thunder Wave from Clefable and Toxic from Clodsire. It also punishes switches that Primarina forces and allows it to scout opposing Pokemon. Substitute is also useful to avoid being revenge killed by Rillaboom and Meowscarada while blocking Trick from Pokemon like Choice Scarf Gholdengo. It is also a safe way to bring Primarina to Torrent range. The 8 Special Defense EVs allow Primarina to avoid the 2HKO from Protosynthesis-boosted Choice Specs Walking Wake's Hydro Steam under sun. Both Tera Poison and Steel flip the matchup against Grass-types like Meowscarada, Serperior, and Rillaboom while also turning the tables on Galarian Slowking. With Tera Steel, Primarina resists Gholdengo's Make it Rain and can beat it one-on-one. It can also absorb Galarian Slowking's Future Sight and set up on Hatterene and Clefable.

Primarina fits best on bulky offense teams that appreciate the natural defensive utility that Primarina brings to the table while also being a threatening sweeper itself. Primarina can support teammates such as Weavile, Rillaboom, and Great Tusk by switching in on Zamazenta, Weavile, and Walking Wake. Rillaboom is particulary good, as Primarina covers threats to it like Cinderace, Dragonite, and Skeledirge while appreciating the extra healing of Grassy Terrain. Great Tusk, Rillaboom, and Weavile can threaten Pokemon that would otherwise be annoying for Primarina, such as Galarian Slowking, Ogerpon-W, and Serperior, respectively. Due to Primarina's lack of reliable recovery, it struggles against entry hazards, especially hazard stacking teams. The aforementioned Great Tusk helps it by removing them with Rapid Spin while also being a switch-in to Kingambit that can threaten a weakened Primarina out. Pokemon like Ogerpon-W, Rillaboom, and Serperior can safely switch into Primarina and threaten it with powerful attacks, forcing it to Terastallize or switch out; Pokemon that can switch in on these threats like Kingambit, Rillaboom, Skarmory, and Corviknight make for great teammates. Kingambit is also a huge help, as it beats one of the most common checks to Primarina in Galarian Slowking while appreciating Primarina's ability to safely switch in and beat Zamazenta, Iron Valiant, and Skarmory.

strategies.comments:
Other Options

Fairy (Calm Mind)

Heavy-Duty Boots may be used over Leftovers due to Fairy having poor hazard control, but Primarina finds it a bit harder to set up without passive recovery. Alternatively, Covert Cloak may be used to prevent Alolan Muk's Poison Jab or Sneasler's Dire Claw from inflicting status on Primarina. Chilling Water lets Primarina take on physical attacking walls like Alolan Muk and Hisuian Goodra, as it lowers their Attack to manageable levels, but the greatly reduced base power compared to Surf makes Primarina lose out on OHKOing Landorus and Ursaluna-B and 2HKOing Gholdengo and Skeledirge at +1. An EV spread of 252 HP / 64 Def / 192 Spe with a Bold nature may be considered, as it lets Primarina outspeed and KO Modest Ursaluna-B which otherwise severely damages Primarina with Blood Moon, but the reduced bulk is detrimental to Primarina's ability to check Gouging Fire. If one opts for a fast variant of Primarina, Encore over Draining Kiss or Psychic Noise may also be considered to lock threats such as Belly Drum Azumarill and Bulk Up Corviknight into unfavorable moves. Liquid Voice may be considered to compress the effects of Psychic Noise and Surf into one move, making it easier to fit Encore, but being unable to hit Water Absorb Clodsire is undesirable. Substitute over Draining Kiss can also be considered to dodge status and force damage on switch-ins, but the lack of recovery apart from Leftovers can be detrimental.

Fairy (Assault Vest)

Draining Kiss can be used over Psychic Noise to grant Primarina a form of recovery. However, this comes with the cost of being walled by Poison-types like Toxapex and Amoonguss. Alternatively, Primarina can run Psychic Noise with Liquid Voice, which can block the healing of Dark-types like Alolan Muk, but this restricts its coverage and allows Water Absorb Clodsire to wall it.

movesets.name: Calm Mind (Fairy)
movesets.description:
With an excellent typing and serviceable Speed and bulk, Primarina is one of the better users of Calm Mind for Fairy teams, as it deals with common roadblocks for Fairy like Corviknight, Clodsire, and Choice Scarf Urshifu-R. Psychic Noise prevents all forms of recovery, making it harder for walls like the aforementioned Clodsire and Articuno to keep up with Primarina. Coincidentally, Psychic Noise also helps Primarina muscle past other bulky setup sweepers like Dragonite and Clefable. Draining Kiss improves Primarina's longevity and threatens Dragon- and Dark-types like Roaring Moon and Weavile. Surf sweeps away Heatran, Skarmory, and Choice Scarf Landorus, all of which are nuisances for Fairy teams. 60 Speed EVs let Primarina outspeed Corviknight and prevent it from recovering with Psychic Noise, making it easier to wear down, while the rest of the EVs are invested in Defense and HP to improve Primarina's matchup against Steel teams.

Due to Primarina's relatively low Defense stat, dual screens support from Klefki is vital for its success, as it lets Primarina check Swords Dance Ceruledge and Bisharp. In return, Primarina deals with Clodsire and Corviknight, which all take advantage of Klefki. Iron Valiant deals with Ogerpon formes, Kyurem, and Landorus, which overwhelm Primarina, and also deals with bulky Steel-types like Bisharp and Hisuian Goodra with Close Combat and Ice Punch. In return, Primarina checks Volcarona, which can take advantage of Choice-locked Iron Valiant. Choice Specs Flutter Mane outspeeds and vaporizes Choice Specs Greninja, Choice Specs Latios, Spectrier, and Ogerpon-H; in return, Primarina breaks down defensive Pokemon such as Articuno, Corviknight, Clodsire, and Skarmory for it. Entry hazards, especially Toxic Spikes, greatly hinder Primarina's ability to set up, so Primarina greatly appreciates Hatterene's ability to bounce back entry hazards with Magic Bounce. Hatterene also has a wide array of supportive moves like Nuzzle and Healing Wish which help circumvent Primarina's low Speed and give it a second chance to sweep. For instance, being able to slow down Articuno and Tornadus and subject Corviknight and Toxapex to the prospect of getting fully paralyzed makes Primarina's job easier. Belly Drum Azumarill is a secondary sweeper that deals with Hisuian Goodra and Alolan Muk, which Primarina struggles to beat, and it's also able to threaten Bisharp and Gliscor more. Choice Scarf Enamorus deals with fast threats like Dragapult and Choice Specs Greninja with Moonblast and loves Primarina being able to soften up opposing teams. Enamorus also provides Healing Wish, which gives Primarina a second chance to threaten opposing teams. Clefable can form a Calm Mind core with Primarina to overload special walls like Articuno and Alolan Muk, or it can set Stealth Rock and slow down the opposing team for Primarina with Thunder Wave. Mimikyu provides a failsafe against sweepers like Ceruledge due to Disguise, and it can use a Swords Dance set to clean up opposing teams late-game.

movesets.name: Calm Mind (Water)
movesets.description:
With Calm Mind, Primarina turns into a great option for Water teams against Fighting and Dragon teams, being able to threaten the likes of Scrafty and Hydreigon. When running Liquid Voice, Psychic Noise turns into Primarina's main Water-type STAB move, while running Torrent makes it great coverage against Clodsire. Draining Kiss is Primarina's main source of longevity, being especially effective against the aforementioned Fighting- and Dragon-types. When running Liquid Voice, Primarina can run Ice Beam to threaten Garchomp, Gliscor, and both Landorus formes. Surf is the better option for Primarina when it chooses to run Torrent so it has a stronger Water-type STAB attack. Alternatively, Encore can be used to take advantage of slower walls like Ting-Lu by locking them into an undesirable move. 60 Speed EVs allow Primarina to outspeed Corviknight.

Primarina struggles against Poison-types such as Alolan Muk and Sneasler; therefore, it appreciates teammates such as Swampert and Gastrodon to check them. The two of them also provide an Electric immunity and entry hazard support. Toxapex absorbs Toxic Spikes while dealing with Grass-types that Primarina struggles with such as Meowscarada and the Ogerpon formes. In return, Primarina deals with some of Toxapex's checks like Great Tusk and Mamoswine. Keldeo and Urshifu-R are great offensive teammates that can muscle through Steel-types such as Archaludon, Hisuian Goodra, and Bisharp. Primarina deals with Iron Valiant in return. Choice Scarf Hisuian Samurott handles Ghost-types like Gholdengo, Dragapult, and Spectrier, and in return, Primarina threatens Fighting-types like Urshifu-R and Keldeo. Choice Specs Greninja handles threats that Primarina struggles against, such as the Ogerpon formes, opposing Primarina, Amoonguss, and Okidogi. Ogerpon-W pairs well offensively with Primarina, handling Landorus, Ursaluna, and Iron Treads, while Primarina deals with various Fighting-, Dragon-, and Dark-types like Urshifu-R, Roaring Moon, and Sableye.

movesets.name: Assault Vest (Water)
movesets.description:
Assault Vest Primarina is a solid offensive pivot for Water teams capable of taking hits from threats like Darkrai and Dragapult comfortably. Moonblast nails Fighting-, Dark-, and Dragon-types such as Kommo-o, Darkrai, and Archaludon. Surf handles Steel-types like Gholdengo and Heatran. Psychic Noise catches would-be checks like Toxapex and Water Absorb Clodsire. Finally, Flip Turn can safely pivot in teammates such as Urshifu-R and Hisuian Samurott on walls that check Primarina like Hisuian Goodra and Galarian Slowking. The EV spread enables Primarina to outspeed Corviknight while preventing it from being 2HKOed from Choice Scarf Archaludon's Thunderbolt after Stealth Rock.

Assault Vest Primarina fits best onto more offensive-leaning teamstyles such as rain, making teammates like Barraskewda and Kingdra great partners. While rain is up, they are able to outspeed and check faster threats such as Meowscarada and Kyurem. Barraskewda also uses its strong coverage to break through special walls Primarina struggles with like Hisuian Goodra and Water Absorb Clodsire with Close Combat and Psychic Fangs, respectively. Pelipper enables rain through Drizzle, and its Ground immunity helps against threats like Landorus-T and Great Tusk while being able to pivot Primarina in with U-turn. Hisuian Samurott provides Spikes support with Ceaseless Edge to wear down foes like Alolan Muk and Flutter Mane while using Sucker Punch to catch faster threats like Latios and Spectrier. Choice Scarf Urshifu-R can outspeed and handle threats like Choice Specs Flutter Mane and the Ogerpon formes for Primarina. Swampert provides a strong defensive support, being able to take on Poison- and Electric-types such as Galarian Slowking, Sandy Shocks, and Raging Bolt. Toxapex can handle Grass-types such as Meowscarada and the Ogerpon formes for Primarina, as well as use Toxic to wear down bulky targets like Iron Hands. Alomomola can support Primarina by being able to take hits from physical attackers such as Mamoswine and Kleavor and use Wish to keep Primarina healthy.

movesets.name: Assault Vest (Fairy)
movesets.description:
With an Assault Vest, Primarina leverages its natural special bulk to serve an incredible role on Fairy teams as a special tank, being able to take hits from the likes of Gholdengo, Iron Moth, and Landorus. Surf hits problematic Fire-types for Fairy such as Heatran and Iron Moth while also being able to force out Gholdengo and Spectrier before it uses Calm Mind. Moonblast hits Water-resistant foes like Hydrapple and Kyurem. Flip Turn gives Primarina a solid pivoting tool to switch out on threats it cannot handle, such as Alolan Muk, Articuno, and Hisuian Goodra. Finally, Psychic Noise allows Primarina to hit Poison-types like Amoonguss, Toxapex, and Okidogi. The EV spread used lets Primarina outspeed threats like Adamant Kingambit and Azumaril. The alternative EV spread is a bulkier set that outspeeds Corviknight and makes it more reliable against threats like Choice Specs Latios and Flutter Mane.

With Primarina's limited recovery options, Hatterene provides excellent support, being able to keep entry hazards off the field and allowing Primarina to come in safely. Hatterene can also spread paralysis against threats like Gholdengo, Tornadus-T, and Gallade using Nuzzle. Klefki can provide hazard and dual screens support, allowing Primarina to combat special walls like Alolan Muk and Hisuian Goodra. Clefable can provide hazard support in Stealth Rock, along with Wish support to heal Primarina. Flutter Mane appreciates Primarina's neutrality to Steel-type attacks from the likes of Choice Scarf Gholdengo, while Primarina appreciates Flutter Mane's strong movepool that can hinder problematic threats like Articuno, Ogerpon-H, and Raging Bolt. Flutter Mane also enjoys Primarina's Flip Turn to grant it safe entry. Primarina values physical Iron Valiant's ability to remove special walls like Blissey, Galarian Slowking, and Clodsire. In return, Iron Valiant takes advantage of Primarina's ability to take on threats like Choice Scarf Latios, Choice Specs Dragapult, and Choice Scarf Enamorus. Mimikyu appreciates Primarina's pivoting to grant it safe entry and setup opportunities. In exchange, Primarina welcomes Mimikyu's ability to remove threats like Flutter Mane and Iron Hands. Choice Scarf Enamorus can remove fasters threats like Sneasler and Iron Valiant and provide Healing Wish support.

movesets.name: Little Mermaid
movesets.description:
• With its great bulk, power, and typing, Primarina is a fantastic offensive and defensive presence in the BSS metagame.

  • Sparkling Aria: Sparkling Aria allows Primarina to get around Substitute attempts from foes like Garganacl that might try to stall out Moonblast.

  • Psychic Noise: Psychic Noise can allow Primarina to potentially muscle through walls such as Toxapex by preventing them from healing off its attacks. Additionally, it allows Primarina to better stand up to Ogerpon formes running Horn Leech as their Grass-type STAB move.

  • Energy Ball: Energy Ball provides Primarina with coverage to hit other Water-types, being particularly useful against Ogerpon-W and other Primarina.

  • Aqua Jet: Aqua Jet can allow Primarina to finish off weakened foes that might otherwise outspeed it, notably allowing Assault Vest variants to more consistently win the Flutter Mane matchup.

  • Flip Turn: Flip Turn allows Primarina to scout switches and provide safe entry for its teammates.

Other Options

  • Perish Song: If utilizing Choice Specs, Perish Song can allow Primarina to pressure foes that might otherwise wall it and disrupt attempts at Baton Pass use.

  • Tera Blast: If using Tera Fire, Tera Blast grants Primarina coverage to hit opposing Grass-types such as Serperior.

Items

  • Assault Vest: Assault Vest accentuates Primarina’s excellent special bulk, allowing it to more effectively trade hits with threats such as Flutter Mane.

  • Choice Specs: Choice Specs allows Primarina to more effectively leverage its fantastic STAB combination, turning it into a shockingly powerful wallbreaker.

EV Spreads

  • 180 HP / 252 SpA / 76 Spe with Modest: This spread maximizes power and bulk while allowing Primarina to keep pace with uninvested base 70 Pokemon like Wo-Chien.

Tera Types

  • Tera Dependancy - Low: Primarina’s incredible base typing allows it to go head to head with many prominent metagame threats without needing to Terastallize.

  • Fire: Tera Fire grants Primarina important Grass, Fairy, and Steel resistances while maintaining its all important Ice resistance.

  • Poison: Tera Poison allows Primarina to deny Toxic attempts from the likes of Toxapex and Gliscor while still granting it a Fairy resistance.

  • Water: Tera Water grants an extra boost to Sparkling Aria while remaining a good defensive typing.

movesets.name: Calm Mind
movesets.description:
• This set's write-up has not started yet, but here's some basic info to get you started!

  • Psychic Noise and Liquid Voice: Liquid Voice turns Psychic Noise into a Water-type attack, giving up Sparkling Aria's power under Torrent in exchange for better match-ups against defensive Pokemon like Toxapex.

movesets.name: Focus Sash
movesets.description:
• Using a Focus Sash on Primarina may seem like a waste, but Primarina's high Special Attack, Sparkling Aria ignoring Substitute, and Torrent make it very tricky for offensive teams to check.

  • Aqua Jet: Despite it being weak, Aqua Jet's ability to pick off faster Focus Sash foes like Iron Bundle makes it essential.

  • Encore: Thanks to the Speed investment, this Primarina is especially good at catching normally faster, bulky Pokemon like Calm Mind Raging Bolt and Stamina Archaludon off guard.

  • Psychic Noise: Psychic Noise is Primarina's best option for shutting down Toxapex, Porygon2, and defensive Dragonite's walling capabilities, and it even punishes Horn Leech Ogerpon-H.

  • Energy Ball: Energy Ball improves Primarina's odds of winning mirror matches, and it deals more damage than anything else to Alomomola and Swampert.

  • Calm Mind: Calm Mind's boost lets Primarina potentially OHKO bulkier Assault Vest Ursaluna-B variants.

  • Speed EVs: Maximizing Primarina's Speed lets variants with a Modest nature outspeed up to Landorus-T with no Speed investment. While the power drop from Timid loses a guaranteed OHKO on offensive Ursaluna-B, it does let Primarina outspeed the rare but very dangerous Adamant Breloom.

Other Options

  • Icy Wind: Icy Wind's speed control comes in handy against defensive Dragon Dance Dragonite, but Primarina's low Speed makes it a lesser option.

Tera Types

  • Tera Dependency - Low: Primarina will usually only Terastallize to improve its power or gain certain immunities, since Focus Sash makes this Pokemon rather disposable. Otherwise, it's best to leave Terastallization for other teammates.

  • Water: Tera Water's boost to Sparkling Aria makes it the easiest choice to recommend.

  • Stellar: Since Primarina rarely terastallizes anyways, Tera Stellar's flexibility can make sense for late-game sweeping scenarios.

  • Ground: Tera Ground saves Primarina from Electric-type attacks, with Raging Bolt and Tera Electric Chien-Pao being particularly good foes to flip.

  • Ghost: Despite Primarina's low Speed, most Extreme Speed Dragonite sets are slower than this set, letting Tera Ghost potentially ruin a revenge kill attempt.

strategies.comments:
Teambuilding

  • Primarina fits well on balance teams, as it benefits from utility moves like Fake Out, healing, and redirection support that allow it to attack freely while other Pokemon cover its weaknesses.
  • Primarina synergizes well with Sneasler, as Sneasler covers its Grass-type weakness. Additionally, Rillaboom offers Fake Out utility and passive Grassy Terrain recovery, benefiting a bulkier attacker like Primarina.
  • Electabuzz is an effective redirector, shielding Primarina from threats like Archaludon and Sneasler while also redirecting Spores from Amoonguss thanks to its Vital Spirit ability and providing speed control with Electroweb. Similarly, Magmar makes a great partner with its access to Vital Spirit and Follow Me. In addition, Magmar resists Rillaboom's Grass-type attacks and can use Will-O-Wisp to compensate for Primarina’s lower physical bulk.
  • Though Primarina sits in an awkward Speed tier, it can operate on teams with a Trick Room mode such as compositions with Porygon2 and Ursaluna.
  • Kingambit is a strong offensive partner for Primarina. With Primarina's chip damage, Kingambit can more easily secure KOs with Sucker Punch. Additionally, most Kingambit sets include Swords Dance, allowing it to punish passive plays and forcing the opponent to choose between Primarina or Kingambit to target.
  • Gholdengo is another common partner for Primarina, as they effectively cover each other's weaknesses. Primarina threatens Pokemon like Incineroar and Garchomp, which can beat Gholdengo, while Gholdengo walls and pressures threats like Sneasler, Rillaboom, and Amoonguss.

Strategy Comments

  • As a slower-paced offensive piece, Primarina excels when it's positioned to safely chip away at opponents. For instance, being alongside a redirection Pokemon allows it to unleash substantial chip damage with Hyper Voice. Due to its respectable bulk, Primarina can often continue using Hyper Voice until a Pokémon that poses a significant immediate threat, such as Rillaboom, enters the field.
  • The strategy with Primarina is to wait for the opportunity to establish a strong offensive position. Typically, this involves pivoting it around until it can come in and clean up effectively mid- or late-game.
  • As mentioned earlier, Rillaboom and Archaludon are significant threats; however, Sneasler effectively counters both. When facing opposing Sneasler or setup sweepers like Gholdengo or Volcarona, it's crucial to position Primarina correctly—either by placing it next to a redirector, so it can attack freely, or by utilizing other Pokemon to apply more immediate pressure. This is because Primarina is most effective when its consistent spread chip damage is sufficient to prevent it from being outpaced on offense.

movesets.name: Bulky Attacker
movesets.description:
• Primarina excels at dealing consistent damage and wearing down opposing Pokemon. Its strong offensive typing, high Special Attack, and ability to take advantage of STAB Hyper Voice with Liquid Voice make it a formidable threat. Additionally, it puts pressure on common metagame Pokemon like Incineroar and Garchomp.
  • Haze prevents setup Pokémon from exploiting Primarina's slower offensive pace. More importantly, it's often used to counter the Dondozo and Tatsugiri matchup.
  • While Throat Spray provides a power boost after using Hyper Voice, Life Orb offers more immediate damage, making it better suited for more aggressive teams. For example, Life Orb guarantees an OHKO on Hisuian Typhlosion with Hyper Voice while allowing Primarina to 2HKO Sneasler and Choice Specs Gholdengo with Hyper Voice. Sitrus Berry, on the other hand, enables Primarina to take on a more passive role, consistently enhancing its survivability. For instance, Sitrus Berry's recovery enables it to live two Stomping Tantrums from Life Orb Garchomp.
  • Tera Poison allows Primarina to resist both of Sneasler's STAB moves and, unlike the other two recommended Tera types, doesn't introduce many common weaknesses. Tera Steel gives Primarina an immunity to Poison-type moves like Sneasler's Dire Claw and a resistance to Steel-type attacks, making it particularly effective against Gholdengo's Make it Rain. Tera Grass, like Tera Poison and Tera Steel, offers a resistance to Grass-type moves from Pokemon like Rillaboom. It also provides a resistance to Electric-type attacks like Electro Shot from Archaludon, and an immunity to Spore, preventing Amoonguss from shutting it down.
  • With the given Defense and HP investment, Primarina is guaranteed to survive Grassy Glide from maximum Attack Rillaboom and a 100-Base Power Last Respects from non-Adaptability Choice Band Basculegion. The Special Defense investment ensures it can withstand Tera Steel Make it Rain from Choice Specs Gholdengo, Blood Moon from Life Orb Ursaluna-B, and two Freeze-Dry hits from Alolan Ninetales. The Special Attack investment gives Primarina a good chance to OHKO Garchomp with Moonblast and non-bulky Talonflame with Hyper Voice, while the Speed investment is designed to outspeed maximum Speed Maushold in Tailwind.

strategies.comments:
Other Options

On RegenVest sets, Psychic can be used instead of Psychic Noise for a chance to 2HKO Iron Moth but is generally less useful due to the latter's denial of HP recovery. Hydro Pump can also be considered for more immediate damage on RegenVest sets in place of Energy Ball or Surf. Primarina does have a few niche sets, mainly a physically defensive set with the Stamina ability and Leftovers. This set aims to rack up stat boosts through its ability and the move Calm Mind to sweep with the move Stored Power.

Checks and Counters

Electric Types: Electric-types like Zapdos and Sandy Shocks force out Primarina with their strong attacks, often 2HKOing RegenVest sets and OHKOing offensive Primarina.

Desolate Land Users: Desolate Land users such as Heatran and Moltres can deny Primarina's Flip Turn and take all of Primarina's attacks relatively easily.

Grass-Types: Primarina is threatened by several Grass-types that are staples on teams in the tier. On the physical side, it is threatened by Power Whip from the Ogerpon formes and Flower Trick from Sword of Ruin Meowscarada. On the special side, Sinistcha threatens Primarina with Matcha Gotcha and can often KO it after a Calm Mind boost.

movesets.name: Choice Specs
movesets.description:
Primarina is one of the strongest special wallbreakers in the tier, with an excellent typing that gives it opportunities to switch in and spam its powerful and reliable STAB moves. Primordial Sea boosts Weather Ball and lets Primarina check Desolate Land users such as Moltres, non-Discharge Iron Moth, and non-Gunk Shot Cinderace. However, these same threats are also great checks to Primarina if they negate Primordial Sea, so Psychic is helpful as the strongest option against them, particularly Iron Moth, while Psychic Noise is a weaker alternative that prevents recovery moves from Moltres and Iron Moth. Flip Turn lets Primarina pivot on special walls such as Manaphy and Bulletproof Iron Treads, generating momentum for its team.

Primarina fits well on balance and bulky offense teams, where its mix of defensive utility and offensive pressure is put to good use. It resists the STAB moves of many common Choice item wallbreakers such as Chien-Pao and Zamazenta, though it still needs backup from physical walls like Corviknight and Pecharunt, especially against the Ogerpon formes. Great Tusk and Corviknight can also provide entry hazard removal, letting Primarina stay healthy so it can threaten out the aforementioned Choice Band wallbreakers. Faster special attackers such as Zapdos, Latios, and Deoxys-S are also problematic, so special walls such as Iron Treads and Swampert are good teammates. In exchange, Primarina can deter Fire-type moves that threaten Corviknight and Iron Treads. Primarina struggles against special walls like Manaphy and the aforementioned Desolate Land users, especially specially defensive Moltres, so it appreciates physical attackers like the Ogerpon formes and Roaring Moon.

movesets.name: RegenVest
movesets.description:
An excellent type combination, good natural bulk and access to Flip Turn allow Primarina to function as a solid RegenVest user . Psychic Noise hits Desolate Land Iron Moth and Moltres for a good chunk of damage and denies recovery as well. Energy Ball is useful against Swampert, Manaphy, and opposing Primarina. This moveslot may also be swapped for Surf or Hydro Pump to provide a second powerful STAB option for more reliable neutral damage against Corviknight and Skarmory. This set runs a Speed-reducing nature and 0 Speed IVs to ensure that Primarina is the slowest Pokemon on the field and can safely pivot to bring in teammates using Flip Turn.

RegenVest Primarina performs well as a bulky pivot on offensive archetypes due to its excellent mixed defensive profile, checking tier staples both on the physical and special side. Although it cannot learn Knock Off, unlike other RegenVest Water types, Primarina is able to counter the likes of Roaring Moon, Chien-Pao, Great Tusk, and Zamazenta with its Fairy typing, as well as handling specially offensive threats such as Gholdengo and Latios quite well. This set must be wary of potential Knock Off users as its ability to take special hits is crippled if it loses its Assault Vest. Therefore, Primarina appreciates support from teammates like Great Tusk and Corviknight to absorb Knock Off; they can also aid Primarina with entry hazard removal. Strong Electric-type attackers like offensive Iron Hands, Zapdos, and Sandy Shocks can pressure and break through Primarina, so it could use Electric-immune teammates like Great Tusk, Iron Treads and Volt Absorb Corviknight. Desolate Land users such as Heatran or Moltres can deny Primarina Flip Turn pivots and immediately threaten it with Solar Beam. Primordial Sea Zapdos or Well-Baked Body Gholdengo can switch into these threats and give Primarina safe entry.

strategies.overview:
Draft Order: Round 4 onwards

Price Range: 11-12 points

Overview: Primarina is an excellent offensive threat thanks to its high Special Attack, enabling it to punch holes in opposing teams with its powerful STAB combination. It also possesses a nice defensive typing and special bulk, allowing it to check many special attackers and take on a role as a setup sweeper when using Calm Mind. Primarina can sometimes struggle to stay on the field due to its poor Speed and physical bulk, but it is still a dangerous offensive threat that must be carefully managed by your opponents.
strategies.comments:
Common Roles

Wallbreaker: Few Pokemon can stomach the combination of Choice Specs-boosted Moonblast or Hydro Pump, allowing Primarina to severely dent or outright OHKO many Pokemon. Flip Turn allows Primarina to generate momentum for its teammates, taking advantage of most unfavorable matchups it encounters.

Setup Sweeper: Primarina's impressive special bulk and excellent defensive typing allow it many opportunities to set up a Calm Mind, preparing it to sweep. Draining Kiss allows Primarina to stay healthy, and Psychic Noise helps break down bulky Pokemon that attempt to check Primarina. Liquid Voice turns Psychic Noise into a Water-type move if the coverage is not useful in the matchup, allowing more room for utility alongside Calm Mind, such as Substitute.

Defensive Pivot: With defensive investment, Primarina can pivot into many attacks thanks to its great defensive typing and safely pivot to a teammate with a slow Flip Turn. Rocky Helmet can punish anticipated U-turn or Flip Turn, Assault Vest can help sponge special attacks, and Heavy-Duty Boots are useful on pivot sets if you anticipate switching Primarina into entry hazards.

Common Moves

Primary STAB Moves: Moonblast, Hydro Pump, Sparkling Aria, Surf, Draining Kiss, Alluring Voice

Setup Moves: Calm Mind

Utility Moves: Flip Turn, Substitute, Encore, Haze

Coverage: Psychic, Energy Ball, Psychic Noise, Ice Beam, Shadow Ball

Niche Moves

Whirlpool + Perish Song: The combination of Whirlpool and Perish Song can be used to trap and remove pivots or troublesome Pokemon that otherwise wall Primarina, such as Toxapex, Blissey, and other specially bulky Assault Vest users.

Aqua Jet: Due to the combination of Moonblast and Hydro Pump being resisted by few Pokemon, Primarina rarely needs to run coverage moves, leaving ample space for other utility options. Despite Primarina's low Attack, Aqua Jet can be used to pick off weakened Fire- and Ground-types.

Endure: Endure + Custap Berry can be used to launch a Torrent-boosted Water-type move or surprise a faster foe attempting to KO Primarina.

Dual Screens: Primarina can set up dual screens and subsequently pivot to a teammate with Flip Turn to maximize their effect.

Common Items

Choice Specs: Choice Specs boosts Primarina's Special Attack to absurd levels, allowing it to dish out incredibly powerful Moonblast and Hydro Pump.

Leftovers: Leftovers allows Primarina to keep its HP high, supplement the healing gained by Draining Kiss, and is an effective pick for setup variants.

Heavy-Duty Boots: Primarina's typing leaves it vulnerable to all forms of entry hazards, and Heavy-Duty Boots allows it to switch into the field uninhibited.

Assault Vest: Primarina's already high Special Defense is boosted by Assault Vest, allowing it to check dangerous special attackers and retaliate with its powerful STAB attacks or safely Flip Turn to another teammate to handle the threat.

Niche Items

Rocky Helmet: Primarina's poor physical bulk does not allow it to take many strong physical hits, but its typing grants it numerous opportunities to punish resisted pivot moves, such as U-turn and Flip Turn, and other various weaker attackers with Rocky Helmet.

Resistance Berries: Resistance Berries can allow Primarina to maintain offensive investment and surprise KO an opposing Pokemon expecting to knock out Primarina. Kebia Berry allows Primarina to sponge the common Poison Jab or Gunk Shot coverage it encounters from both Urshifu formes and Greninja and subsequently KO them. Wacan or Rindo Berry can be similarly useful.

Choice Scarf: A Choice Scarf and a Timid nature allow Primarina to outpace up to base 114 speed Pokemon. This allows Primarina to surprise OHKO or 2HKO many naturally faster Pokemon such as Garchomp, Latios, and Chi-Yu.

Light Clay: Light Clay can be used when running dual screens to maximize their uptime.

Tera

Primarina has an excellent defensive typing that grants it many opportunities to switch in to attacks during most games, which limits the need for defensive Terastallization. Additionally, its STAB combination already offers great coverage offensively, limiting the need for a different Tera Blast type. However, Primarina can still make good use of Tera both offensively and defensively. On offensive sets, Tera Water or Tera Fairy can push the damage output from its STAB moves even higher, enabling it to score more KOs that it wouldn't normally. Defensively, Primarina can make good use of many different typings, such as Tera Steel, Poison, or Fairy, to sponge hits or give it additional time to set up Calm Mind.

Draft Strategy

Primarina is a great choice for teams that are looking for a relatively self-sufficient wallbreaker that is capable of making extremely effective trades, thanks to the combination of its bulk, defensive typing, and offensive output. It is typically capable of securing KOs by itself, but it shines when placed on an offensive team that can safely pivot it in and provide entry hazard support to amplify its wallbreaking power.

Cleaning Partners: Primarina's wallbreaking capability enables many sweepers to take advantage of the holes it creates in opposing teams. Faster Pokemon like Iron Boulder, Roaring Moon, and Iron Moth are excellent at cleaning up teams weakened by Primarina.

Entry Hazard Setters: With hazards set on the opponent's side of the field, Primarina's offensive prowess shines even further. Primarina can turn many 2HKOs into outright OHKOs, and the hazards add additional chip to bulky Assault Vest users attempting to switch in to sponge its attacks. Gliscor and Sandy Shocks make great partners with their access to Stealth Rock and Spikes, and Primarina covers their weaknesses to Water- and Ice-type moves.

Physically Bulky Partners: Primarina's major weakness is its poor physical bulk, making it essential to have good partners to switch in to powerful physical attackers. Garchomp and Landorus-Therian make excellent partners for Primarina, thanks to their great physical bulk and abilities—Rough Skin and Intimidate—allowing them to check physical attackers .

Checks and Counters

Special Walls: Dedicated special walls or some Assault Vest users are capable of checking Choice-locked Primarina and retaliating or pivoting to a teammate. Blissey and Toxapex, in particular, can shrug off Primarina's STAB moves and set up entry hazards or inflict status on Primarina. However, many special walls can be defeated by setup variants of Primarina, so they must be cautious when switching in.

Phazing and Encore: Calm Mind variants of Primarina are vulnerable to Encore and phazing moves due to Primarina's low Speed and lack of access to Taunt.

Strong Physical Attackers: Primarina's poor physical bulk leaves it liable to being quickly KOed by strong physical attackers. Many of the format's Dragon- or Fighting-types are often able to power through Primarina with their secondary STAB moves or coverage options before it can react.

movesets.name: Life Orb
movesets.description:
• This spread allows Primarina to beat Pokemon that it usually can't, such as Timid Weakness Policy Iron Crown and non-Agility Corviknight.
  • Generally, the sequence against Iron Crown is to use Encore on the first turn to lock it into using Calm Mind, then use Icy Wind twice to lower its Speed so Primarina can lock it with Encore back into Calm Mind in the following turn, then use Moonblast once and use Encore once again, then alternate between Hydro Cannon and Encore, keeping the recharge turn and Life Orb damage in mind. In case Iron Crown uses Tachyon Cutter on the first turn, it activates Torrent on turn two, which allows Primarina to OHKO it with Hydro Cannon.
  • This spread allows Primarina to survive a Poison Jab or Sludge Wave from Adamant Choice Band Urshifu formes and Timid Life Orb Landorus and then OHKO them with Moonblast or Icy Wind, respectively.
  • An alternative EV spread of 56 HP / 192 Def / 8 SpA / 252 Spe lets Primarina bulk Jolly Choice Band Urshifu formes' attacks but not Adamant Choice Band variants, dropping that matchup in order to gain a more consistent Iron Crown matchup, since Primarina's higher Speed stat means it can outspeed Iron Crown after a single Icy Wind and threaten Special Attack Booster Energy variants with a Torrent-boosted Hydro Cannon if Iron Crown decides to go for an attack. This spread also allows Primarina to outspeed Ursaluna and OHKO it with Hydro Cannon.
  • Against Spectrier, use Encore on turn one. If Spectrier attacks on turn one, use Hydro Cannon on turn two. If Spectrier uses a status move, use Icy Wind thrice with the main spread or twice with the alternative spread, then use Encore to lock Spectrier into a status move while dealing damage with Moonblast and Hydro Cannon.
  • Moonblast allows Primarina to beat commonly used Dragon- and Fighting-type Pokemon, such as Roaring Moon, Dragapult, the Urshifu formes, and Iron Valiant.
  • Since Primarina is weak to Poison-type or STAB attacks from foes such as Sneasler, Pecharunt, Volcanion, Hoopa, Raging Bolt, and Ogerpon-Wellspring, it is suggested to pair Primarina with Dragon- and Steel-type Pokemon such as Roaring Moon, Iron Crown, and Metagross to form the well-known Dragon / Fairy / Steel core.

movesets.name: Weakness Policy
movesets.description:
• Primarina is one of the strongest Pokemon in 1v1 thanks to its unique typing, important role compression, and variety of sets.
  • The combination of Weakness Policy and Charm or Reflect allows Primarina to take care of slower threats that aim to defeat it with their super effective moves, such as Iron Hands with Supercell Slam and Donphan and Ursaluna with Gunk Shot.
  • Charm can work multiple times, which can help if Primarina is trying to stall a foe or to get to Torrent range to fire off an extremely strong Hydro Cannon, while Reflect can take care of Clear Amulet Pokemon, an item these Pokemon can run to be a hard counter to the Charm variant.
  • Hydro Cannon can KO Ursaluna and Donphan after a boost from Weakness Policy on the former and a Draining Kiss on the latter.
  • Draining Kiss and Moonblast can threaten both Urshifu formes, and while Draining Kiss is especially helpful for the Donphan matchup, Moonblast can also be utilized for overall damage against Haxorus.
  • Calm Mind lets it set up in front of potential threats like Clear Amulet Cresselia.
  • Thanks to its huge investment in Speed, Primarina can outrun Ursaluna, Iron Hands, and Donphan while threatening KOs in return, with its Defense and HP maximized for the best rolls against Choice Band Haxorus.
  • Primarina should be used in teams where its weaknesses to Grass, Electric, and Poison are patched up, so it really likes pairing with Dragon-types like Raging Bolt, Steel-types like Corviknight and Hisuian Goodra, or Psychic-types like Hoopa-U and Iron Crown.

movesets.name: Custap Berry
movesets.description:
• Custap Berry Primarina looks to flip matchups it usually loses, like Choice Specs Kyurem, and provide reliability against Landorus-T; it achieves this by surviving attacks it would normally be OHKOed by with Endure, moving first on the second turn with Custap Berry, and firing back with its extremely strong attacks.
  • Hydro Cannon can hit both Ursaluna formes, Skeledirge, and Great Tusk, and it's boosted by Torrent if Primarina is at or below 1/3rd of its maximum HP, which is often reached when Primarina loses enough health for Custap Berry to activate the following turn, allowing it to outspeed and wash out these Pokemon with little issue.
  • Moonblast hits Haxorus, Iron Valiant, and both Urshifu formes.
  • Encore helps against Pokemon that attempt to set up on or attack Primarina like non-Choice Scarf or Specs Porygon-Z and Weakness Policy Metagross, while Calm Mind helps it boost against the likes of Passho Berry Volcarona.
  • Primarina's HP and Defense EVs help it survive a Timid Life Orb Landorus's Sludge Wave as well as an Adamant Choice Band Urshifu's Poison Jab, with the remaining EVs going into Special Attack.
  • Primarina finds itself struggling against Grass-, Electric- and Poison-types like offensive Ogerpon-W, Raging Bolt, and Pecharunt, so it appreciates having partners that can deal with these threats like Hoopa-U and Iron Crown.

movesets.name: Choice Specs
movesets.description:
• Hydro Cannon is Primarina's strongest attack and should be used against both Landorus formes, non-Custap Berry Skeledirge, and non-Substitute Volcarona.
  • Moonblast defeats Haxorus and Garchomp.
  • Energy Ball should be used against Rhyperior and is Primarina's best way to deal with non-Sap Sipper Azumarill.
  • Liquid Voice + Uproar makes Primarina defeat Registeel and gives it an option to defeat Custap Berry Skeledirge and Substitute Volcarona, while Psychic Noise + Torrent allows it to beat Whimsicott reliably. Torrent Primarina is also more consistent agaisnt bulkier Choice Specs Hoopa sets, as Moonblast does not always OHKO them.
  • The HP and Defense EVs allow Primarina to survive Earthquake from Choice Band Landorus-T, while the Special Defense EVs allow it to survive Sludge Wave from Timid Choice Specs Landorus.
  • Choice Specs Primarina, unlike other Primarina sets, loses to Encore + Disable Iron Valiant sets, so it is important to use a teammate that can defeat the aforementioned sets.

movesets.name: Bulky Calm Mind
movesets.description:
Possessing decent bulk and a stellar typing, Calm Mind Primarina can sweep teams with its near-perfect offensive coverage. With valuable resistances to offensive typings like Dark and Fighting, Primarina can check common Pokemon such as Urshifu-R and Hisuian Samurott and even set up on them. Although Primarina competes with Tapu Fini for the same role, it has useful traits that separates it. Scald is a consistent damaging move that works well alongside Calm Mind, giving it chances to burn switch-ins such as Ferrothorn, Galarian Slowking, and Toxapex. Scald should be paired with Torrent for an extra damage boost at low health, guaranteeing the OHKO on Mega Diancie and, when Calm Mind-boosted, breaking through Galarian Slowking and Z-Move Gholdengo. Psychic Noise combined with Liquid Voice is slightly weaker than Scald but lets Primarina stop healing from Pokemon like Alomomola, Toxapex, and Zapdos; it also allows Primarina to beat other setup Pokemon like Substitute Volcarona in a one-on-one. Draining Kiss helps Primarina stay healthy and gives it more chances to sweep through teams, while Moonblast has a much better damage output, keeping Pokemon like Ogerpon-W and Tapu Lele from coming in as freely. Leftovers offsets damage taken from Substitute. 124 Speed EVs allow Primarina to outspeed 0 Speed Mega Scizor and Raging Bolt and other Pokemon around its Speed tier, like Clefable and Corviknight, which Primarina can boost up on behind a Substitute.

Primarina provides good value for bulky offense teams; it checks Dark-type Pokemon such as Hisuian Samurott and Weavile and Fighting-types like Urshifu-R and Zamazenta while also threatening sweeps of its own. Weavile itself and Kingambit make nice teammates, as they appreciate Primarina's help against Urshifu-R and annoying Fire-types like Moltres and Volcarona, and in return, they Pursuit trap threats to Primarina's sweep like Galarian Slowking. Dragonite defends against Ogerpon-W and Kartana in exchange for Primarina weakening and potentially burning Steel-types like Ferrothorn, Mega Scizor, and Melmetal and chipping Fairy-types such as Hatterene, Iron Valiant, and Tapu Fini. Primarina has a hard time breaking through Grass-types like Ogerpon-W and Ferrothorn, so teammates such as Rillaboom and Volcarona can be paired with Primarina to give it better odds of breaking through or finishing off weakened teams. Rillaboom notably provides Grassy Terrain, which provides additional healing and makes Primarina better defensively against Ground-types like Garchomp and Landorus-T. Rillaboom is also good at baiting in Pokemon like Ferrothorn and Toxapex and weakening them for Primarina, which switches well into threats to Rillaboom like Cinderace and Dragonite. Poison-types like Toxapex and Galarian Slowking can be tough for Primarina, so it can pair with Heatran and Gholdengo while pressuring their checks such as Hisuian Samurott and Ting-Lu. Primarina can struggle with entry hazards due to its lack of immediate recovery, so it appreciates hazard removers like Great Tusk and Landorus-T. These Pokemon can scare out Galarian Slowking, Raging Bolt, and bulky Steel-types like Melmetal, while Primarina can beat Urshifu-R and Alomomola and pressure Flying-types like Corviknight and Moltres for them.

movesets.name: Assault Vest
movesets.description:
Thanks to its good special bulk and defensive typing, Primarina with an Assault Vest can function as a defensive pivot capable of checking powerful special attackers like Mega Latios, Tapu Lele lacking Psyshock, and Volcarona. It can also check some physical attackers like Urshifu-R and Zamazenta. It performs a crucial offensive role alongside its vital defensive role, being able to exert pressure on common defensive backbones like Gliscor, Ting-Lu, and Moltres. Despite Primarina's excellent special bulk, it often competes with less entry hazard-prone pivots with good longevity like Alomomola and Pecharunt, although it can exert more offensive pressure. Scald is preferred over other Water-type attacks like Surf and Hydro Pump, as it can burn physical attackers like Melmetal, Kingambit, and Mega Scizor, hindering their offensive presence. Flip Turn lets Primarina generate momentum for its teammates and pivot out of healthy checks like Galarian Slowking and Ferrothorn. Psychic Noise is a coverage move that allows Primarina to super effectively target and deny recovery for Poison-types like Pecharunt, Toxapex, and Mega Venusaur on the switch in as well as being able to prevent Alomomola from Wish passing. Torrent is the preferred ability, as it further increases Primarina's damage output and trading capabilities, allowing it to score a guaranteed OHKO on Tapu Koko and Tornadus-T after Stealth Rock. A Modest nature increases Primarina's damage output, allowing it to OHKO maximum HP Landorus-T after Stealth Rock. 176 Speed EVs ensure that Primarina outspeeds Adamant Kingambit.

Primarina fits best on offense and bulky offense teams that appreciate its ability to serve as a specially defensive blanket and pressurize the likes of Gliscor and Heatran. Potent wallbreakers like Mega Diancie and Tapu Lele appreciate Primarina's ability to muscle through the aforementioned defensive Pokemon. In return, they break common defensive backbones in Zapdos and Toxapex that Primarina struggles to force progress against. Powerful wallbreakers and sweepers such as Volcarona, Ogerpon-W, and Urshifu-R benefit from Primarina's ability to threaten Dragon-types, including Dragonite and Mega Latios. Primarina appreciates their ability to threaten Steel-types such as Melmetal and Ferrothorn in return. Primarina's glaring weakness to entry hazards means it appreciates excellent hazard removal options like Great Tusk, Terapagos, and Defog Landorus-T. Additionally, Great Tusk can switch into common physical attackers such as Kingambit and Mega Tyranitar, while Landorus-T can switch into Electric-type Pokemon like Tapu Koko lacking Hidden Power Ice and Raging Bolt, which Primarina struggles against defensively. In return, Primarina can comfortably switch into wallbreakers like Iron Valiant and Mega Latios, which the aforementioned hazard removal options in Great Tusk and Landorus-T struggle against. Viable revenge killers such as Zamazenta, Mega Lopunny, and Weavile are also appreciated, as they threaten defensive staples that Primarina cannot consistently pressurize like Ferrothorn and Galarian Slowking. As a teammate, Primarina can prevent defensive pieces that check the aforementioned revenge killers like Mega Venusaur and Pecharunt from remaining healthy. Primarina struggles against Grass-types such as Ogerpon-W and Serperior, which means that Grass-type answers such as Dragonite and Melmetal are appreciated. In return, Primarina acts as a check to certain foes that can revenge kill Dragonite, such as Urshifu-R and Tapu Lele, and Fire-types like Volcarona and Heatran, which Melmetal cannot defensively answer.

movesets.name: Calm Mind
movesets.description:
This spread prevents Substitute from being broken by Amoonguss’s Sludge Bomb at +1.

These are sample sets, stay tuned for future updates!
